purpose: Validate the Markovian cavity-decay assumption by comparing HEOM (cavity Fock space, position-quadrature Drude-Lorentz bath) against Lindblad (sqrt(kappa)*a collapse operators) at target kappa/omega_c values.

scope.bath: Drude-Lorentz structured bath coupled through position quadrature (a + a†)
scope.relationship_to_track_b: Validates the Markovian cavity-loss assumption used for all headline retention numbers in the manuscript

units.lam: Drude reorganization coupling in omega_c units

markovian_comparator.construction: kappa_markov = 2*pi*J(omega_c) with J(w) = 2*lam*gamma*w/(w^2+gamma^2); collapse operators: sqrt(kappa*(n+1))*a, sqrt(kappa*n)*a†
markovian_comparator.note: The Markovian kappa is derived from the same Drude-Lorentz parameters used for the HEOM bath; kappa_ratio_error reports the self-consistency.

validation.numerical_physicality_note: Trace/Hermiticity/eigenvalue acceptance is not a proof of exact positivity.
validation.positivity_gate_note: Rows whose HEOM trajectory violates the numerical eigenvalue gate are preserved as inconclusive and excluded from agreement claims.

caveats: This validates the Markovian cavity-decay assumption, not the full Dicke+DCE protocol.
The Drude-Lorentz spectral density is a model for the transmission-line continuum; real cavities may have different bath structures.
Agreement is conditional on the tested truncation, hierarchy depth, temperature, and time window.
Inconclusive rows are retained, not hidden.
